description: Change a kit sound's take as it is, free: say what is off in the user's words (change, any language) or name the action. Three versions come back as new takes of the sound (a light, medium and strong change; for a loop, three seamless loops of 12-14 s for a steady sound), with file links; the take in use stays until pick_kit_take. No generation is used and no plan is needed. When the words ask for a different sound rather than a change to this one, it answers no_action with the writer's description: the user can make that at kit_url. Let the user listen and pick one.

action.description: crisper: too muddy; heavier: too light; shorter_tail: rings on too long; longer_tail: stops too abruptly; room: too dry; far: too close; loop: make it loop

change.description: What is off, in the user's words: 'too muddy', 'make it loop', 'sounds too close'.

kit_id.description: The kit id from start_game_kit or add_kit_sounds (kit_…).

take_id.description: The take to change (default: the sound's take in use).

name: change_kit_take
